claim.text: It is highly recommended to create a dedicated workspace for managing the OAuth2 application.
claim.label: official_docs
claim.evidence_quote: It is **highly recommended** you create a workspace for the purpose of managing the OAuth2 Application, as each admin user will have access.

claim.text: The authorization_code grant type is always required.

claim.text: OAuth2 apps can have up to 1000 active client credentials tokens in parallel.
claim.label: official_docs
claim.evidence_quote: OAuth2 apps can have up to 1000 active client credentials tokens in parallel, provided each token uses the same scopes.

claim.text: Access tokens are valid for 24 hours.
claim.label: official_docs
claim.evidence_quote: The access token is valid for 24 hours and will need to be refreshed when it expires.

claim.text: Refresh token requests have a 30-minute grace period for retries.
claim.label: official_docs
claim.evidence_quote: Requests to consume a refresh token and obtain a new one have a 30-minute grace period to allow for network errors.

claim.text: Client credentials tokens are valid for 30 days.
claim.label: official_docs
claim.evidence_quote: The token generated using this grant type will be an `app` actor token that has access to all public teams in the workspace and is valid for 30 days.
